reviews.text: Five star experience in every single aspect of our pool renovation, from our first contact to completion.  We can't say enough about the professionalism and work ethic of Dallas Cool Pools.  Rick & Jessica offer personalized care and constant communication regarding each detail throughout the process.  Rick's ability to listen to our vision and stay within our budget put him at the top of our list after multiple consultations and estimates with other companies. No pressure, just honest options of what DCP could offer to meet our needs. His commitment was evident throughout the remodel and he was ALWAYS available to address any questions or concerns.  We built our original pool in 2002 and knew the plaster could no longer withstand another season.  The craftsmanship, expertise and attention Rick's team gave to our long awaited pool project was exceptional! Although we have not completed the surrounding areas in the backyard, you can certainly see the difference compared to previous photos.  It is bright, refreshed and better than ever! No doubt our family & friends will enjoy it with us for years to come. Thank you, DCP!
reviews.author: KD

reviews.text:
Ricardo with Dallas Cool Pools is the best! 🚀

He was so patient with our pool remodel in answering all of our questions and helping us through design choices. He always communicated well throughout weather and material sourcing delays, and the end result is a well built and beautiful pool.

Even after completion and final payment, Ricardo still responds quickly to my questions and is simply a tremendous partner. He is very knowledgeable about the entire process and his crew is incredibly talented.

For some more detail I included some before and after shots that show the work they did to:
-Convert our built in spa into a tanning ledge
-Extend the shallow area
-Install new travertine pavers + waterline tile 🤩
-Resurface all plaster

If I ever needed pool work done again in the DFW area, Ricardo is surely who I will call. Thank you Dallas Cool Pools team! 🙌
reviews.author: Travis Rose

reviews.text:
I've dealt with several pool remodelers over the years, but none as honest, transparent, and reputable as Dallas Cool Pools. The owner, Ricardo Rodríguez not only does he follow up during every stage of the project but he follows up afterwards once completed as well to make sure his customers are completely satisfied. That to me counts as 5 ⭐ Customer Service. When it comes to pool equipment, Ricardo vast experience always recommends the best quality equipment and latest state art on the market. Hire Dallas Cool Pools today, you won't regret it.

NOTE: The pictures are not AI generated, these are my pictures. These are before and after pictures.
reviews.author: Mike Rosado

reviews.text: Ric at DCP is great. His customer service is fantastic and has a superb attention to detail. He maintains great relationships with his clients. In fact, he asked his prior clients if I could tour their backyard to get a idea of their pool color. So that’s a testament of his great long term relationships.
reviews.author: Mark Woodling

reviews.text: We used Dallas Cool Pools to remodel our 40+ year old pool. We had the coping, tile, and plaster redone. Plus had an in-line chlorinator added and some minor plumbing work done. Ricardo was the most organized, responsive and professional of all the contractors we interviewed. throughout the entire process, he was there to answer questions and discuss what was happening. I mentioned to my husband towards the end of the project that Ricardo is by far the easiest, most responsive contractor I have ever worked with. On top of that, the quality of the work is top notch. The work exceeded my expectations. Great job, Ricardo and team!
reviews.author: Missy

reviews.text: Highly recommend Dallas Cool Pools for the renovation work they recently did on our pool! Ricardo worked with us to stay within our budget while delivering excellent craftsmanship and beauty. We resurfaced the pool with PebbleTec, replaced the dated spotter tiles with a modern glass trim line, installed lighting and remortared our spa waterfall to the pool! (We opted to keep current tiles and coping) Other companies we researched would only do one or some of the things, Dallas Cool Pools provides the entire turnkey package! Great job!
reviews.author: Sarah Moore

reviews.text: Highly recommend! Can’t say enough positive things about our experience with Epic. Great knowledge and communication. Ricardo couldn’t have been better to work with. Very competitive pricing. When an issue did arise, they pointed it out and promptly addressed the problem.
reviews.author: Keir Simon

reviews.text: I highly recommend Dallas Cool Pools. The owner, Ricardo recently built our pool and spa, and my family has been enjoying it daily ever since. He was willing to work with our design ideas and budget, while also suggesting some great features we hadn't thought of. He communicated with us regularly, was well-informed, and always went the extra mile to make sure everything was just right. Thanks Dallas Cool Pools, we love our new backyard.
reviews.author: Stephen Nanney

data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic and detailed. The high ratings are supported by specific, credible customer stories across different project types. The identical review count (44) on Google and Yelp is unusual but could indicate a data sync or the business actively managing both profiles; the detailed content outweighs this as a minor anomaly.
authentic_signals: Extremely specific project details (converting spa to tanning ledge, travertine pavers, plaster resurfacing)
Mention of specific crew/owner names (Rick, Jessica, Ricardo, Shawn)
Mix of project types (renovations, new builds, liner replacements)
Emotionally authentic language expressing gratitude and relief
Owner responses are personalized and thankful
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google and Yelp, both showing excellent scores with identical review counts (44). No BBB profile found is not a red flag for a smaller contractor.
